package.description: Show SoundCloud, YouTube Music, and Apple Music playback as a Discord Listening status

en-US.description: Show SoundCloud, YouTube Music, and Apple Music playback as a Discord Listening status
en-US.longDescription: Chunes runs in the Windows notification area and shows SoundCloud, YouTube Music, and Apple Music browser playback as a Discord Listening activity. It clears the status when playback pauses and labels each supported service correctly. Pair it with the Chune ID browser extension for accurate service detection.
en-US.name: Chunes
